bug_1_nestgate_404.why: CF Pages serves nestgate.io but engine.html was added by DSBioLab after the last sporePrint build. the page exists in git but isn't deployed to CF Pages.
bug_1_nestgate_404.delicacy: this bug reveals that CF Pages is STALE — the inflammation response worker is trying to fix this. the bug is EVIDENCE the tunnel bypass is needed.

bug_2_wasm_render_fallback.what: engine.html tries PetalTongue WASM import from /wasm/petal_tongue_wasm.js — falls back to text if WASM fails
bug_2_wasm_render_fallback.why: WASM rendering requires init() + render_dashboard() with correct DataBinding JSON format. DSBioLab already fixed the channel_type field name. but render_dashboard may still fail → falls back to render_binding per-item → falls back to text percentages.
bug_2_wasm_render_fallback.delicacy: the fallback chain is CORRECT engineering. degrade gracefully. three levels of rendering: WASM SVG → WASM per-binding → plain text. each level works.
bug_2_wasm_render_fallback.nutrition: vitamins (resilience — graceful degradation is immune tolerance)

bug_3_swarm_chitter_raf_poll.what: swarm-chitter.js runs pollEar() inside requestAnimationFrame loop AND also setInterval
bug_3_swarm_chitter_raf_poll.why: rAF fires 60fps but pollEar has a 3141ms (π seconds) guard. double-polling wastes cycles but doesn't break anything.
bug_3_swarm_chitter_raf_poll.delicacy: minor inefficiency. the rAF loop should just handle animation, not polling. separate concerns.
bug_3_swarm_chitter_raf_poll.nutrition: fiber (cleanup — separate animation from data polling)
bug_3_swarm_chitter_raf_poll.fix: remove pollEar() from rAF loop. the setInterval already handles it at π-second intervals.
